disposition_reason: The paper has an ordered decoding task, but the original release/splits, exact ROC-AUC panel numbers and full source aggregation have not been recovered. The registered implementation tests word responsiveness and cannot stand in for that baseline.

source_paper.title: Brain Treebank: Large-scale intracranial recordings from naturalistic language stimuli

evidence.locator: Section 4, Fig. 4 and Appendix A.4-A.9; supplementary Figs. 5-7
evidence.supports: Separates descriptive word responsiveness from held-out single-electrode sentence/word/POS decoding and defines data, preprocessing, split and ROC-AUC display conventions.
Identifies the NeurIPS 2024 dataset paper and original ten-participant cohort.
Decimates by ten, applies StandardScaler in the logistic-regression pipeline, cross-validates training ROC-AUC and returns test ROC-AUC.
Different runner paths exist; neural-runner train/validation list appends are reversed and the generic all-ROC summary is not automatically the paper top-ten figure aggregation.
Existing evaluator is a word-responsiveness t-test component with prospective corrections, not the source held-out decoder or a published-score reference.

target.description: Original ordered task: single-electrode time-resolved classification of sentence onset versus no speech (Fig. 4), with word-onset and noun-versus-verb companion tasks in Figs. 6-7. Counts of significant electrodes and stronger word-response p-values are not performance improvements.

dataset.description: Original 2024 Brain Treebank release and movie-aligned annotations are identified, but exact versioned recording, transcript, electrode and example inventories that produced the published decoding panels are not frozen. A later expanded release is not interchangeable.

cohort.description: Ten epilepsy participants viewing their recorded English movies. Paper removes 114 corrupted contacts; subject 5 is excluded from anatomical-region analyses because of a frontal lesion, while remaining non-region analyses retain that participant. Preserve the source electrode and region inclusion rules.

split.description: Appendix A.9 specifies per-electrode 80/20 train/test with shared splits within participant and five-fold training CV; exact source example IDs, negative subsampling, random seeds and configured regression runner remain unverified. Do not use the neural-runner swapped-index code path to infer paper splits.

inputs.description: Single-electrode neural activity in 250-ms windows stepped by 100 ms from -1 to +1 s; the prediction input is neural activity, not transcript/audio labels or multiple-electrode features. Sentence timestamps construct targets and no-speech examples.

preprocessing.description: Recorded sEEG is 2048 Hz. Decoder decimates by ten and uses training-fitted zero-mean/unit-variance scaling. Sentence-positive examples are two-second centered epochs; negatives are drawn from speech-free three-second segments, with balanced classes and the specified temporal buffer. Exact native reconstruction still needs validation.

metric.description: Higher ROC-AUC on held-out examples for each electrode/time window; probabilistic ranking AUC = P(score_positive > score_negative) + 0.5 P(tie). Chance is 0.5. Preserve score curves and source peak-over-time summaries rather than substituting accuracy or significance.

aggregation.description: Fig. 4a maps per-electrode peak ROC-AUC, and Fig. 4c averages time courses of the ten electrodes per region selected by peak training-CV ROC-AUC. Exact top-ten identities, figure values and a source-equivalent complete-panel decision statistic remain unrecovered. The script generic mean over every ROC is not that panel.

comparison.primary_metric: Held-out ROC-AUC for the original sentence-onset decoding panels, with source electrode/time aggregation

published_baseline.description: Primary article contains ROC-AUC plots but reviewed text does not supply an exact numerical panel baseline with recoverable source aggregation. Peak timing (100/300 ms), chance 0.5 and significant-electrode counts are not the decoder baseline.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Author regression route is identifiable; no native rerun, frozen source split or verified numerical figure reproduction exists here.

minimum_effect.rationale: Meaningful AUC gain cannot be set before recovering the original panel values and selecting an explicit full-panel source comparison; avoid selecting only favorable electrodes or times.

uncertainty.method: Resolve source panel and use paired participant-level uncertainty with electrode/time/movie dependence retained; specify multiplicity over evaluated panels and any peak selection before final evaluation.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Participant, with movies, electrodes, epochs and windows nested or dependent.
uncertainty.rationale: Paper electrode confidence bars are descriptive and do not by themselves justify treating selected electrodes or overlapping epochs as independent units for a new superiority claim.

paper_win_requires: Recover exact original release, example/split manifest, electrode exclusions, top-ten selection and numerical author ROC-AUC results for the declared complete paper panel.
Reproduce the author logistic-regression baseline on the original examples and preserve its single-electrode input condition and all source windows.
Freeze a meaningful-effect and participant-aware uncertainty rule and show a gain against both the published source result and the reproduced author comparator under equal declared access/resources.
Do not claim a paper win from the local word-responsiveness t-tests, more significant contacts, new participant/movie splits, pooled multichannel inputs or a cherry-picked region/window.

current_sota.description: This contract compares only with the identified source paper. No current-SOTA search or superiority claim is established.

episode.improvement_loop: Blocked on source recovery. Once admitted, allow development feedback only from the original training/CV portion for the chosen full decoding panel; retain descriptive responsiveness analyses as calibration.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze decoder, training procedure, electrode selection, time-window handling and all source mappings before final test replay.
episode.final_evaluation: Use original held-out examples and the source paper panel aggregation. New blocked-movie or participant holdouts must be labeled extensions and cannot resolve the missing source baseline.
episode.baseline_policy: Compare against the source logistic regression with its training-only scaler and original split; do not relabel the independent paired-t evaluator as the author baseline.

blocking_issues: Recover source ROC-AUC arrays or an independently reproduced exact author baseline for the full original panel.
Freeze original recording/transcript/example and electrode inventories, negative-sample selection, split seeds and the correct regression runner configuration.
Verify train-only top-ten electrode selection, complete time-window coverage and paper panel aggregation; generic all-ROC averaging is not equivalent.
Validate native alignment/preprocessing and retain documented corrupted-contact and subject-5 region exclusions.
Define meaningful effect, participant-aware uncertainty, fixed access/resource budgets and a working protected decoding evaluator.

legacy.notes: Preserve the five-window paired word-response component and prospective multiplicity correction as calibration only. It does not implement time-resolved decoding or establish a published performance baseline.
